formula_definitions.description: One feature at a time: source band, target band, polysemy, POS shape, or shadow coverage.
Hand-authored additive formulas to compare intuitive compositions.
Risk is the largest single warning signal.
Additive formula with a source-frequency by polysemy product term.
Discrete normalized weight sweep across the five family-level signals.

methodology.internal_split: stable family_id hash modulo 4; one bucket is locked-eval proxy and three buckets are discovery proxy. This guards against selecting a formula entirely on the same families it is judged on, but it is not a real future heldout set.
methodology.promotion_boundary: This can choose the next LLM data-allocation hypothesis; it cannot prove product quality or promote runtime scoring.
methodology.purpose: Compare programmatic family-level heuristics for ranking the source-target families most likely to benefit from LLM-generated semantic evidence.

next_steps: Use the best stable formula family to choose a small top-N LLM evidence pilot.
Include low-ranked controls in that pilot so the ranking can be falsified.
Do not tune runtime thresholds from this report alone.
